vocabulary.definition: the act of making something seem simpler than it really is
vocabulary.example: The explanation given to the students was an oversimplification of the complex scientific concept.

vocabulary.definition: a subtle difference or distinction in expression, meaning, response, etc.
vocabulary.example: The actor's performance was so nuanced that it conveyed a range of emotions with just a glance.

vocabulary.definition: without any mistakes or imperfections; perfect
vocabulary.example: Her presentation was flawless, captivating the audience from start to finish.

vocabulary.definition: a skeptical attitude; doubt as to the truth of something
vocabulary.example: Healthy skepticism is important when evaluating new information to avoid falling for misinformation.

vocabulary.definition: provides a reason for doing something; encourages action
vocabulary.example: His passion for music motivates him to practice every day to improve his skills.

vocabulary.definition: the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea, and in terms of which it can be fully understood
vocabulary.example: To truly understand the meaning of the text, one must consider the historical context in which it was written.
